notes: Item 19 is present and contains extensive financial performance data across multiple sections: (I) Merchandise Margin and Net Revenue percentages for franchised stores, (II) Average Net Revenue by quartile/thirds/percentages for corporate, franchised, and combined stores, (III) Unaudited P&L and EBITDA for company-owned stores including monthly breakdown, (IV) Sales Achievement Club data (not extracted as individual cohort metrics since they are award count data, not revenue metrics per se), and (V) Commercial as a Service data (images not readable, skipped). The Section D cross-selling table reports a period of Sep 1, 2024 to Aug 31, 2025, which differs from the primary Fiscal Year (Jan-Dec 2025). Multiple tables report different average values for the same 490-store franchised cohort (e.g., $833,660 in Table A-2 vs $954,716 in Table B-2 and C-2); these are reported as-is. Section V (Commercial as a Service) charts appear to be images and could not be extracted. Bottom Quartile/Table A-3 shows $539,235 without dollar sign — interpreted as $539,235. Monthly EBITDA data for individual months is available in source but only annual totals extracted here to reduce record count. Company-owned store EBITDA figures include imputed royalties and marketing (5% each of Net Revenue) as disclosed.
